title: Mixing structure
goal: Buses, sends, groups, VCAs, sidechain and bounce/stems in the document, meeting the production-level criteria list.
done: Graph-level PDC across send, aux and sidechain paths (M1).

humanGates.text: Name the reference machine per platform for the 64-track criterion.
humanGates.how: The maintainer names the machines; runs are recorded per release.

features.title: Buses, aux inputs and sends in the document
acceptance: bus.add, send.add (pre/post) and routing commands with declared cascades; document-level PDC null tests across sends and aux returns.

features.title: Groups and VCAs
acceptance: VCA effects on derived gain are not touched entities; group edits are one revision.

features.title: Sidechain routing
acceptance: Sidechain inputs from the document line up with the main input (null test).

features.title: Bounce and stems
acceptance: render.bounce job produces content-addressed outputs; stems per track or bus; offline equals realtime null test.

exit.how: 64 tracks at 48 kHz/128 samples for 30 minutes with zero xruns on the reference machines (human gate), PDC null tests, recovery and parity tests.
